message: The other day, I decided it was high time to check our go-bags. You know, just to see if we were ready for anything. I opened mine and found an old snack granola bar, a crumpled map from our last road trip, and a rubber chicken. 🤦‍♀️ So, I guess my preparedness plan was more of a comedy show! After a good laugh, I realized it’s never too late to update our supplies and have a real plan in place. What’s your funniest ‘not quite ready’ moment?
